testimonials.text: The most interesting aspects of the nasal reconstruction course were the detailed breakdown of anatomical variations, the step-by-step explanation of techniques, and the practical surgical decision-making tips shared by the instructors. I particularly appreciated the focus on functional-aesthetic balance, graft selection, and complication management, which gave me a deeper and more structured understanding of modern approaches to nasal reconstruction.

The presentation was well detailed, and the diagrams eased my understanding of the concepts. The ladder system was well portrayed and I can't wait to practice it on the ground. This has made constructive surgery all interesting!
